author: SciShow
description:
This video was sponsored by Breakthrough Energy.

A reliable grid powered by green energy is going to need batteries, too. Not just electric cars—think solar power on a cloudy day. Lucky for us, there’s an old battery showing new promise for long-duration energy storage. And its secret is rust.

Hosted by: Tom Lum (he/him)
